gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Distinctive and round, Baloo Tamma 2 leads with big open shapes. Be Vietnam Pro follows in a sans with curve endings held well apart, so paragraphs move along without any snagging.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-epilogue: Approachable from the first glance, Baloo Tamma 2 sits up top with generous, open letters. Epilogue's wire-thin monoline skeleton and stubby ascender tips below give the page a lighter, more contemporary hand to settle into.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-fira-sans: Commanding in a rounded, friendly way, Baloo Tamma 2 never closes its bowls. Fira Sans does the steadier work beneath, its larger x-height and stout diagonals making a sans-serif that holds its own in the text.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-merriweather-san: Commanding but never cramped, Baloo Tamma 2 gives headings big counters to breathe in. Merriweather Sans carries the text with tall lowercase that makes words look sturdy, and an e that opens clearly to the right.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-public-sans: Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad counters on c and s to the text. Baloo Tamma 2 above it adds a distinctive, tall-lowercase heading, and the whole page reads smoothly.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-ranade: Distinctive and bold in its tall lowercase, Baloo Tamma 2 takes the heading. Ranade follows as a sans-serif with only slight weight shifts and stroke ends set far apart, so a long read feels spread out and unhurried.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-supreme: Big counters in a tall lowercase give Baloo Tamma 2 its commanding, open face. Supreme stays crisp across a long stretch, a sans-serif whose heavy-looking band of text keeps letters held open rather than curled shut.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-general-sans: Big, open, and a bit cheeky, Baloo Tamma 2 makes the heading hard to ignore. And General Sans carries the text with an x-height that fills the line and curves that glide around each bend without thinning.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-manrope: Manrope pairs a minimal cap-to-lowercase step with a bright open gap at every curved letter's mouth, under Baloo Tamma 2. Words flow through it smoothly.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-montserrat: Baloo Tamma 2 leads with big counters in a tall lowercase that never snag on a closed-up bowl, giving headings a commanding, distinctive look. Montserrat glides along below, its oversized e and a counters keeping the text open.
